## Simulation study

### setting 1

a mixture whose two components are clearly separated. 

```{r}
#generate a dataset

set.seed(1)

n <- 100
allocation <- rbinom(n, size = 1, prob = 0.7)
separate_data <- allocation*rnorm(n, -2, 1) + (1 - allocation)*rnorm(n, 2, 1)

```

Initialisation 1: $\mu_1 < \mu_2$.
Initialisation 2:$\mu_1 > \mu_2$.

```{r}
source("sampler.R")
set.seed(1)

hyperparams = list(
  m_0 = 0,
  s2_0 = 1,
  a = 1,
  b = 1,
  alpha_0 = 2,
  beta_0 = 1
)

initialisation1 <- list(
      mu_1    = -1,
      mu_2    = 1,
      pi      = 0.5,
      sigma2  = 1
    )

initialisation2 <- list(
      mu_1    = 1,
      mu_2    = -1,
      pi      = 0.5,
      sigma2  = 1
    )

separate_gibbs1 = gibbs_sampler(separate_data, 2000, 2000, hyperparams, initialisation1)
separate_gibbs2 = gibbs_sampler(separate_data, 2000, 2000, hyperparams, initialisation2)

mu_1_vector1 <- sapply(separate_gibbs1, function (x) x$mu_1)
mu_2_vector1 <- sapply(separate_gibbs1, function (x) x$mu_2)
pi_vector1 <- sapply(separate_gibbs1, function (x) x$pi)
sigma2_vector1 <- sapply(separate_gibbs1, function (x) x$sigma2)

mu_1_vector2 <- sapply(separate_gibbs2, function (x) x$mu_1)
mu_2_vector2 <- sapply(separate_gibbs2, function (x) x$mu_2)
pi_vector2 <- sapply(separate_gibbs2, function (x) x$pi)
sigma2_vector2 <- sapply(separate_gibbs2, function (x) x$sigma2)

```



```{r}

png(file="./figures/task2_partB_setting1_trace.png")

par(mfrow=c(2,2))

plot(mu_1_vector1, type = "l", ylab = expression(mu[1]), ylim = c(-3,3), 
     main = expression( paste("Trace: ", mu[1])), col="blue")

lines(mu_1_vector2, type = "l", col="orange")

plot(mu_2_vector1, type = "l", ylab = expression(mu[2]), ylim = c(-3,3),
     main = expression( paste("Trace: ", mu[2])) , col="blue")

lines(mu_2_vector2, type = "l", col="orange")

legend("topright",
       legend = c(
         expression( paste("Initial ", mu[1], "<",  mu[2])), 
         expression( paste("Initial ", mu[1], ">",  mu[2]))),
       col = c("blue", "orange"),
       lty = 1,
       cex = 0.8)

plot(pi_vector1, type = "l", ylab = expression(pi), ylim = c(0,1),
     main = expression( paste("Trace: ", pi)), col="blue")

lines(pi_vector2, type = "l", col="orange")

plot(sigma2_vector1, type = "l", ylab = expression(sigma^2),
     main = expression( paste("Trace: ", sigma^2)), col="blue")

lines(sigma2_vector2, type = "l", col="orange")


dev.off()

```


```{r}

png(file="./figures/task2_partB_setting1_init1_acf.png")

par(mfrow=c(2,2))

acf(mu_1_vector, main = expression( paste("ACF: ", mu[1])))
acf(mu_2_vector, main = expression( paste("ACF: ", mu[2])))
acf(pi_vector, main = expression( paste("ACF: ", pi)))
acf(sigma2_vector, main = expression( paste("ACF: ", sigma^2)))

dev.off()

```


```{r}

png(file="./figures/task2_partB_setting1_init2_acf.png")

par(mfrow=c(2,2))

acf(mu_1_vector, main = expression( paste("ACF: ", mu[1])))
acf(mu_2_vector, main = expression( paste("ACF: ", mu[2])))
acf(pi_vector, main = expression( paste("ACF: ", pi)))
acf(sigma2_vector, main = expression( paste("ACF: ", sigma^2)))

dev.off()

```


### setting 2

A mixture whose not clearly separated

```{r}

#generate a dataset

set.seed(1)

n <- 100
allocation <- rbinom(n, size = 1, prob = 0.7)
separate_data <- allocation*rnorm(n, -0.5, 1) + (1 - allocation)*rnorm(n, 0.5, 1)

```

#### Initialisation $\mu_1 < \mu_2$

```{r}

source("sampler.R")
set.seed(1)

hyperparams = list(
  m_0 = 0,
  s2_0 = 1,
  a = 1,
  b = 1,
  alpha_0 = 1,
  beta_0 = 1
)

initialisation <- list(
      mu_1    = -1,
      mu_2    = 1,
      pi      = 0.5,
      sigma2  = 1
    )

separate_gibbs_1 = gibbs_sampler(separate_data, 2000, 2000, hyperparams, initialisation)
separate_gibbs_2 = gibbs_sampler(separate_data, 2000, 2000, hyperparams, initialisation, allow_switching=FALSE)

mu_1_vector <- sapply(separate_gibbs_1, function (x) x$mu_1)
mu_2_vector <- sapply(separate_gibbs_1, function (x) x$mu_2)
mu_1_vector_2 <- sapply(separate_gibbs_2, function (x) x$mu_1)
mu_2_vector_2 <- sapply(separate_gibbs_2, function (x) x$mu_2)
pi_vector <- sapply(separate_gibbs_1, function (x) x$pi)
pi_vector_2 <- sapply(separate_gibbs_2, function (x) x$pi)
sigma2_vector <- sapply(separate_gibbs_1, function (x) x$sigma2)

```

```{r}

#png(file="./figures/task2_partB_setting2_init1_trace.png")

par(mfrow=c(2,2))

plot(mu_1_vector, type = "l",
     ylab = expression(mu[1]), 
     main = expression( paste("Trace: ", mu[1], " without restriction")), col="blue", ylim=c(-3, 3))

lines(mu_2_vector, type = "l", col="orange")

plot(mu_1_vector_2, type = "l", ylab = expression(mu[1]), 
     main = expression( paste("Trace: ", mu[1], " with restriction")),col="blue", ylim=c(-3, 3))

lines(mu_2_vector_2, type = "l",col="orange")

plot(pi_vector, type="l", ylab = expression(pi), 
     main = expression( paste("Trace: ", pi, " without restriction")), ylim=c(0, 1) )

plot(pi_vector_2, type="l", ylab = expression(pi), 
     main = expression( paste("Trace: ", pi, " with restriction")), ylim=c(0, 1) )

#dev.off()

```


```{r}

png(file="./figures/task2_partB_setting2_init1_acf.png")

par(mfrow=c(2,2))

acf(mu_1_vector, main = expression( paste("ACF: ", mu[1])))
acf(mu_2_vector, main = expression( paste("ACF: ", mu[2])))
acf(pi_vector, main = expression( paste("ACF: ", pi)))
acf(sigma2_vector, main = expression( paste("ACF: ", sigma^2)))

dev.off()

```







## Aplication to the faithful dataset
```{r}

hyperparams = list(
  m_0 = 0,
  s2_0 = 1,
  a = 1,
  b = 1,
  alpha_0 = 1,
  beta_0 = 1
)

mean <- mean(faithful$eruptions)
std <- sd(faithful$eruptions)
preprocessed_data <- (faithful$eruptions - mean)/ std

```

```{r}
set.seed(1)
faithful_gibbs <- gibbs_sampler(preprocessed_data, 100, 100, hyperparams)
```
